newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Sept 16.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Sept 16.

text.p: These are significant stories in the Ivorian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Ivory Coast's Commodities Minister Guy-Alain Gauze elected president of the International Cocoa Organisation at its general assembly in London.
- Government re-advertises privatisation of two more state-owned blocks of oil palm after a first tender attracted no bids. The sale of another block was re-advertised last month.

- Future of debt-ridden multinational carrier Air Afrique to be decided in less than two months when new chief executive will be nominated. Frenchman Yves Roland Billecart was forced to end his tenure following union pressure.
- Industrial Development Minister Theophile Ahoua N'Doli starts factory visits for on-the-spot assessment of problems of local industries.
